sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants the Court to reverse the lower court decision. He seeks a rule that Miranda violations never create civil liability.
the opposing side wants the Court to affirm the lower court decision. He seeks to keep the civil lawsuit alive for the officer.

paragraphs: This case defines the scope of civil liability for police officers. It determines whether citizens can sue officers personally for skipping Miranda warnings. The outcome shapes the balance between police accountability and operational freedom.
